cards.title: Repeating text with *
cards.body: Multiplying a string by a whole number repeats it.

hi.title: * se text repeat karna
hi.body: String ko kisi whole number se multiply karo toh woh repeat ho jaata hai.

cards.title: Lines that grow
cards.body: Combine the loop variable with string repetition and each line can be a bit longer than the last.

hi.title: Badhti hui lines
hi.body: Loop variable ko string repetition ke saath jodo, toh har line pichli se thodi lambi ho sakti hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Type 5 and it crashes with a `TypeError`. The error points at line 2: tap the line that really causes it.

bug.fix: `input()` gives text, and text can only be repeated a whole number of times. Line 1 needs `int(input())`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: 5 type karo toh yeh `TypeError` dekar crash hota hai. Error line 2 dikhata hai: us line par tap karo jo asal mein problem hai.
hi.fix: `input()` text deta hai, aur text sirf whole number baar repeat ho sakta hai. Line 1 ko `int(input())` chahiye.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: i is 0 and then 1, so the lines have 1 and then 2 stars.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: i pehle 0 aur phir 1 hai, isliye lines mein pehle 1 aur phir 2 stars hain.

exercise.prompt: Read N and print a triangle of N rows: row 1 has one `*`, row 2 has two, and so on, with no spaces.
exercise.promptHi: N padho aur N rows ka triangle print karo: row 1 mein ek `*`, row 2 mein do, aur aise hi aage, bina spaces ke.

n = int(input())
